Commentary.Commentary: The Indian players line up in front of the cameras with the trophy. India take the T20I series. They will look to keep the momentum as they go in the ODI series. The first match is on 6th October at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). Do join us early for the build up. Cheers!

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India says that as a team no matter what happens with the result they would always try to get better as a team. Adds that other teams are challenging and one needs to find the answers all the time and jokingly adds that Sky’s form is a bit of concern. Mentions that on a serious note they need to work on their bowling department and says that they are working towards it. Tells that guys need a lot more clarity and it is his job to provide that. Mentions that a lot of the guys haven’t been to Australia before and adds that’s why they wanted to go first and adjust to the pace in Perth. Tells that they will play practice games there and that will help them and adds that they are trying to improve and it is an ongoing process. Says that Bumrah is a big miss and they have a couple of guys in reckoning who can replace him and hopes that they will do well in Australia.

Suryakumar Yadav wins the Player of the Series award for his scintillating batting performance. He says that he does not follow stats personally but his friends keep sending him the stats on WhatsApp. Tells that his thought process was the same in this game and he just wanted to build partnerships but it did not work out in this game. Says that he was demoted down the order because Dinesh Karthik needed to spend some time in the middle and he praises Dinesh Karthik as well for the way he played. Tells that he has not thought about Australia much but he is looking forward to the challenge.

Rilee Rossouw wins the Player of the Match award for his wonderful century. He says that every cricketer goes through bad form and he adds that he knew that something special was coming up. Tells that De Kock backed him and told him that he will score runs in this game. Mentions that it is special to score runs against India in front of a packed crowd and he is happy with his performance. Tells that he is glad to score runs.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says that a win like this is big for their confidence. Tells that in the first game, batting was not upto the mark and in the second game, the bowling did not do well but says that in this game they were a lot more clinical. Mentions that the ODI series is important for them as they need points from that series and says that it is an opportunity for guys who will come with fresh energy to show their worth and also to build towards the World Cup in Australia.

Rahul Dravid, the Head Coach of India says that they are happy to get the right results in both the series after Asia Cup. Adds that in this format, one needs a bit of luck and it did not go their way in Asia Cup but against Australia, it went well and says that they are happy with the way they played. Tells that in the whole year they batted quite well and made a conscious effort to bat positively after the last World Cup.  Bumrah is a terrific player for India but it is an opportunity for other players to stand up but adds that they will surely miss him. Mentions that this game was an opportunity to give some guys who did not get to bat much earlier and says that it is pleasing to see Karthik and Pant batting well. Says that he was happy with the way they kept playing positive cricket till the end.  Tells that they gonna do their best in the World Cup and they have prepared well. Adds that in a tournament like World Cup, one needs some luck along with playing well and he hopes that they do well. Tells that they get good support they go in the world and they will try to do their best in the World Cup as well.
...The Presentation...

India on the other hand, just could not get going. Dinesh Karthik played brilliantly but could not kick on. They needed a big stand or someone to score a big score but that did not happen. In the end they went down by a huge margin despite the knock from Deepak Chahar at the back end.
All of their bowlers got a wicket at least, they did go for a few runs but the key was picking wickets which they did. Dwaine Pretorius ended with three wickets to his name.

A consolation win for South Africa but a morale boosting one. The ton from Rilee Rossouw set it up. That saw South Africa end with a massive score and then their bowlers came to the fore. They kept picking wickets despite going for runs which just made it difficult for South African to finish the game pretty early.

OUT! TAKEN! The stubborn tail end batting is finally over. Fuller ball, around off. Siraj launches it straight but does not get enough distance on it. It ges to long off where David Miller takes it. South Africa win by 49 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: Full, slow and outside off. Siraj has a big swing but misses.
A full ball, outside off, driven to covers for a single.
Wide! Dwaine Pretorius is struggling very much! Again this is outside off.
Wide! Alength ball, outside off. Yadav shuffles across as he looks to go big but misses.
On middle, shorter side and Siraj misses his pull.
A slower bumper, outside off. Siraj tries to dab it away but misses.
FOUR! A yorker on off. Siraj opens the face of the bat and steers it through backward point for a boundary.
Short of a length and on middle. Siraj swings and misses.
This is outside off. Yadav dabs it to backward point. There is a shy at the bowler's end but Rabada fails to collect the ball cleanly. Should have been run out.
A yorker on leg. Kept out.
A slower full ball, outside off, worked to long off for one.
Outside off. Yadav slashes and misses.
Very full and outside off. Siraj carves it to deep point for one.
OUT! TAKEN! The entertainment is over! A slower ball, full and outside off. Chahar swings his bat across but this time toe ends his shot to the point region where David Miller takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Deepak Chahar is playing a superb cameo. Pitched up, outside off. Chahar hammers it over covers for a six.
Full ball, outside off. Yadav smashes to long off for a single.
Wide! Again this is over the tramline.
Wide! The South African bowlers are sill struggling. A length ball, outside off, over the tramline.
A length ball, outside off. Yadav slaps it to deep cover for a single. India need 69 runs in 24 balls.
Wide! This is way outside off, slower and Yadav leaves it alone.
Very full and on middle. Yadav drives it to long on and comes back for the second.
FOUR! Runs still coming for India! The game is still on! A low full toss, outside off. Yadav drives it through covers for a boundary.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
This is full and outside off, Chahar comes down the track to smash it away but misses this time.
SIX! Another full toss on middle and Chahar smacks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. The crowd erupts after quite a while.
No ball! A full toss, outside off. Yadav thumps it back to Ngidi who lets it through for a single. A no ball is called for height. Free hit coming up.
SIX! Deepak Chahar is not letting it go away easily! A full toss on off. Chahar smashes it high over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Flatter and on the pads. Chahar pulls and it goes over short fine leg for a boundary.
A single as this is hit to long on.
Leg bye! This is angled onto the pads. Chahar misses his sweep and it goes off the pads behind the keeper for a leg bye.
Very full and outside off. Chahar tries to heave but miscues back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off. Defended out.
A yorker on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Wide! A bouncer, slower one and Yadav misses his pull. Wided.
FOUR! A full toss on middle. Yadav lofts it over the bowler's head and to long off for a boundary. Good shot.
Short of a length and slanting on middle. Yadav looks to pull but misses.
A single as this is worked to long on.
A length ball, around off. Defended out.
A length ball, outside off. Yadav taps it to point for one.
A single to end then! On the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
On off, this is guided to point.
One, taken single towards long on.
OUT! TAKEN! Number 8 down! Maharaj gets his second! Tossed up on off, this is lofted down towards long off where it is taken by Rabada.
Commentary.Howout: c Kagiso Rabada b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on to the stumps, pushed for a single towards long off.
Outside off, this is played past point for one.
FOUR! Carved away! Outside off, Chahar opens the face of the bat at the very end and plays it past short third man for a boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a clear catch and it has taken the bottom edge! Another wicket for South Africa! Outside off, fuller. Axar goes after it. It goes off the bat and to the keeper. De Kock takes it and appeals. The umpire is not sure whether it carried. He walks to the umpire at square leg and has a chat. It is taken upstairs with the soft signal being out. Replays show that it is a clear catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Wayne Parnell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Thumped down the ground! Fuller and on off, this is hit hard down to the long off fence.
Drives for a single towards cover.
On off, this is guided to point.
Full, flicked down to long on for one.
OUT! TAKEN! Ngidi yet again gets the wicket after going for a few. Fuller and on off, it is the slower one. Patel swings, it goes more off the toe-end and Miller at long off takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone. Wided.
SIX! Patel is not mug with the bat and he is showing it here! Fuller and on middle, this is lofted over the long on fence for a biggie.
On off, a slower one, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Another risky run but no harm done! Length and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one. Bavuma did have a shy but misses.
FOUR! That has been clobbered! Length and around off, this is smacked past the mid off fielder and into the fence.
Full ball, outside off. Harshal drives to deep cover for a single. India need 133 runs in 60 balls.
Fuller ball, way outside off. Axar guides it square on the off side for a single.
A single as this is flicked to deep mid-wicket.
This is way outside off. Harshal looks to drive but misses.
Quinton de Kock thought there was an edge! A length ball, outside off. Harshal looks to work on the leg side but misses and it brushes his pads before going to the keeper.
On the pads, tucked to square leg. A misfield and a single is taken.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Short and on middle, Harshal pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

DROPPED! Tossed up on middle, slower in the air. Harshal flicks it to mid-wicket where the ball falls straight in the hands of Dwaine Pretorius but he fails to hold on. There is a run out chance as Harshal was halfway down but the fielder misses.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.
Short and on middle, Axar pulls it to deep square leg for one.
On middle, blocked back to the bowler.

OUT! TAKEN! Suryakumar goes now and India are in deep, deep trouble. This is full and outside off, the ball just sticks a bit. Suryakumar chips it in the air and to deep point. Stubbs there dives forward and takes a low catch. The umpire just wants to check the catch and the replay shows the catch was taken well over the ground.
Commentary.Howout: c Tristan Stubbs b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: This is outside off. Suryakumar toe ends his drive to mid off where Wayne Parnell collects on a bounce.
SIX! BANG! On a length and outside off. Suryakumar shuffles across and whacks it over fine leg for a biggie.
Angling on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, worked to long on for a single.
This is on a length and outside off, nips away. Suryakumar is squared up as he looks to push.

OUT! BOWLED! Keshav Maharaj has the last laugh and he is pumped up! Absolutely pumped up! Not sure why Karthik went for this shot! He was batting brilliantly without moving much! This is flatter and around off. Karthik tries to reverse scoop it but misses and the stumps are disturbed. South Africa doing well to chip in with wickets.
Bowls it wide of off, slapped straight to cover.
SIX AGAIN! This is tremendous batting from Karthik! He is enjoying batting up the order! Touch short nd on leg, it is pulled over cow corner for a six.
SIX! Karthik continues to go big. A low full toss, around off. Karthik gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket, flat for six.
Yadav is off the mark! tossed up on middle, punched to long off for a single.
On middle, drilled to long on for a single.
On middle, worked to fine leg for one. 19 runs off the over. India will be happy with the Powerplay, 64/3. 164 runs more needed in 84 balls.
On a length, outside off. Karthik punches it to cover where the fielder half-stops and he batters take a couple of runs.
SIX NOW! BANG! Karthik already races to 30 now! This is on the pads, full and it is flicked behind square on the leg side for a biggie.
FOUR MORE! Karthik in full flow! This is full and outside off. Karthik plays a glorious cover drive for a boundary.
SIX! It's raining boundaries at the moment. What a shot! This is full and on middle. Karthik paddle scoops it over fine leg for a biggie.
A full ball on middle, swinging in. Karthik looks to heave but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Suryakumar Yadav comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a team dismissal! Ngidi gets his revenge. A short one just outside off, holds in the surface. Pant checks his cut shot. It goes off the toe-end towards cover where is taken with a dive forward by Stubbs. Just as India started to get going, South Africa strike.
Commentary.Howout: c Tristan Stubbs b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Over the fence! Shorter and outside off, Pant slashes at it, it flies off the outside edge and over the third man fence.
FOUR! Exquisite! Fuller and on off, Pant creams it past the mid off fielder and it races away to the long off fence.
SIX! Stand and deliver! What a shot that is! IN the slot yes, full and on middle, Pant whips it well over the long on fence for a biggie.
On the pads, an inswinger. Pant looks to heave it on the leg side but misses.
FOUR! That is a quality shot! Fuller and on off, Pant drives it down the ground to the long off fence. Lovely stroke. India will want to make this a big over now.
Another cheeky run! On the pads, Pant looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.

Risky run! Length and on off, Karthik plays it late, it goes to the right of the keeper. He runs there, picks it up and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. A single in the end. Pant had to dive to make it in.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Karthik looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Not a lot of bounce again! Shorter and on middle, Karthik looks to pull, it goes off the inside edge and onto the pads.
FOUR! Whipped away! On the pads, Karthik flicks it and it goes over short fine leg for a boundary. India need a few more.
Good length and on off, Karthik plays it towards short third man, he wants a run but is sent back.
Shorter and on middle, Karthik walks across and looks to pull but misses to get hit near the box.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and outside off, Pant cuts it past point and this one races away to the fence. A good end to the over.
Fuller and on middle, Pant whips it but to mid on.
Tip and run! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.

FOUR! That has gone just over! Extra pace and bounce! Length and on off, Karthik has a poke at it. It goes off the shoulder of the bat and over short third man for a boundary. Rabada has been a tad unlucky.
Extra bounce! Length and outside off, Dinesh Karthik looks to guide it down to third man but it goes off the splice and lands short of first slip.
On middle, this is pushed towards cover for one.
BEATEN! That is a good comeback! Length and outside off, angling away. Karthik is beaten as he tries to drive.
FOUR! SHOT! That is a shot of authority to get off the mark! This is banged in short. Karthik pulls it over mid-wicket and it races away to the fence.
Dinesh Karthik comes in early.

A HUGE APPEAL! Parnell is almost celebrating! The finger is raised now and Iyer reviews! OUT IT IS! THREE REDS! India lose another one and are in huge trouble. Iyer's comeback in the side is not a good one. This is on middle, Iyer looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads. The game is slipping away quickly now.
Outside off, Iyer slashes at it but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Iyer looks to flick but misses.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Well outside off, left alone.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Wayne Parnell.
EDGED BUT IT LANDS SHORT! Soft hands! Length and on off, Iyer looks to defend but the ball gets big on him. It goes off the outside edge but lands just short of first slip.
On middle, Pant works it towards mid on and takes one.
Around off, Pant pushes it towards cover.
Good length and on off, Iyer looks to defend, this goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Shreyas Iyer walks out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! The Indian captain walks back for a duck! Ideal start for South Africa and a poor one for India! Length and on off, this one jags back in. Sharma looks to push at it but it goes off the inside edge and then hits the top of off. Pin-drop silence here in the stadium.
Good length and on off, Sharma pushes it to covers.
